items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: This particular show I'm thinking about is the Pat Boone Show

ctx.x: Did you do many public performances

No, I've never really worked on that scale, but I do remember I've been on a couple of shows where there were several bass players. This particular show I'm thinking about is the Pat Boone Show and that was in the late '50s, where there were several basses doing our thing on this show with accompanist piano and like guitar, rhythm and we did our thing on this particular show. That's the only time that I've done any work with more than one bass.
Uh-huh. Now when you were -- when we were talking before, you had said that you didn't go to Europe until the mid-'50s with Norman Granz, but in discussion, we discovered that --
